about: The one-page view: what the system is, its layers, and how the other files in this folder fit. Start here.
authority: editorial summary of CLAUDE.md, src/modules/README.md and src/orchestration/README.md; where a figure or name matters, the per-file JSON beside it is derived from code and wins

identity.repo: video-knowledge: the production tooling (TypeScript, Node, Astro, Remotion)
identity.site: Commonwealth of Reason (commonwealthofreason.com): a fictional state whose commissions publish real evidence reviews
identity.disclosure: The Commonwealth is fictional. The research is real.
identity.channels: each commission is a YouTube channel; only channels a person created have a handle
identity.pitch: Claims from YouTube videos and blog posts are judged against studies, turned into short evidence videos, companion articles and a public record site, by agents writing artifacts that deterministic validators check and a person approving every release.

loop.summary: an agent proposes per institution, another reviews; a person approves
collect, extract, merge, judge against studies, record, report
candidates and their evidence audit; a review makes them ready
package, script, review, storyboard, graphics, lock, render, score, article, package
private upload; one email or the review page; a person decides
go-live or schedule, Shorts follow, the site rebuilt and deployed, an X post
monthly scan for new evidence; reaffirm or correct released articles

loopRule: modules names the capability modules (modules.json) that do the step; columns the artifact columns (objects.json) it writes; orchestration drives every step.

layers.name: A person
layers.what: approves topics, releases, schedules, paid links, corrections; verifies integrations; turns automation on

layers.name: Agents (claude -p)
layers.what: nine roles that write artifacts only (scripts, reviews, batches, proposals, components where the graphics brief allows), never machinery, never a secret, never a publish

layers.name: Orchestration
layers.what: the board (derived stage, next step, halt kind, column) and the executor (runner, tick, work plane, pick, release loop, inbox, launch, discovery, topic runner, maintenance); coordination only, every write a module CLI as a child

layers.name: Modules (capabilities)
layers.what: evidence, stories, script, storyboard, video, packaging, article, shorts, publishing, brand, website, topic-discovery, social, mail, plus shared; each with index.ts (read API) and README.md, and where it has them cli.ts (the write path), briefs/, tests/

layers.name: Artifacts (state is files in the repo)
layers.what: proposals/, topics/<topic>/ (store, sources, scripts/<slug>/, video/, publish.json), src/config/site.ts, automation.json, readiness.json; derived at read, decisions carry who, when and a sha; no database, queue or stored workflow state

layers.name: External services
layers.what: YouTube Data API, Google OAuth, a mailbox (SMTP/IMAP), Azure AI Speech, edge-tts, OpenAI (optional), X API, Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages/Actions, Claude Code CLI, the watcher checkout, Europe PMC/arXiv/YouTube for research

layers.name: Technology
layers.what: TypeScript on Node via tsx; Astro + Tailwind site; Remotion + React renderer; ffmpeg and a PCM mixer; vitest, Playwright, axe, html-validate; eslint, prettier; nodemailer, imapflow, mailparser

flows.research: proposal -> lists -> store (claims, verdicts) -> report -> stories
flows.production: evidence package -> script -> review -> storyboard -> graphics -> lock -> render -> soundtrack -> article -> review package
flows.release: private upload -> request (email binds the manifest sha) -> person decides -> go-live/schedule -> Shorts -> launch job (site) -> X post
flows.maintenance: scan -> record-sources -> report -> revision notes -> stories -> article reaffirm or correction request

files.modules.json: the capabilities, their CLIs, briefs, read APIs and the boundary rules (derived from code)
files.objects.json: every artifact by stage column, who writes it, what makes it valid, and the edges between them (derived from the admin Objects tab)
files.externals.json: every external connection: direction, protocol, secrets, which verb, which flag, readiness state
files.actors.json: the person, the nine agent roles, the automation planes, and what each may write
files.flow.json: the stage machines: research stages, production stages, board columns, halt kinds, and the 25-step workflow with the person's steps marked
files.tech.json: runtimes, frameworks, libraries, tests and quality gates
files.rules.json: the invariants worth drawing: authority, evidence, derivation, secrets, boundaries
